routing.unsupported_rule: required_routes empty is rejected only when no accepted route remains after the existing hard unsupported safeguard

schema_context.stateless: sum selected Top-K schema bytes for every task
schema_context.session: sum only schemas not already exposed in current compaction epoch
schema_context.duplicate_schema_injection: route injected more than once within one compaction epoch

execution_oracle.completion: all required routes selected and each deterministic oracle call schema-valid and semantically valid in required order

post_compaction_recovery.definition: first required route after compaction is injectable again when selected
